summary: Purple-branded page of 9 sections: a head with a 3 by 3 leader portrait mosaic, an overview with video, a story carousel, four link tiles, a success-story block, a podcast strip, client quotes and a dark enquiry form. Needs nine portrait photos, a story of 4 to 5 cards and client quotes.

centered heading with a bold one-line strapline; rounded video thumbnail with play button left, paragraph with firm figures right

brighter purple band with a diagonal light panel; left a very large stacked heading and a short line plus two round arrow buttons; right a sliding row of white cards each with icon, bold title and a paragraph, the fourth card cut off
centered heading and line; four tall photo tiles with a large dark title in the top-left and a round arrow in the bottom-left (links to leadership, culture, insights, giving)
success stories: text with a link left, a person photo with a purple play badge right
slim 300px dark purple podcast strip: one heading and a button
centered heading; three client quote cards with a round photo, quote, name and firm, five links below
